title: Huna Mar son of Rav Idi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 49a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.49a.3): he disagrees with Rav Adda bar Minyumi, and they asked Ravina about it.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Chullin gives Huna Mar son of Rav Idi and Rav Adda bar Minyumi as the two disputants, followed by the question to Ravina. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=976&lang=en) cites the same page with the patronymic Iri.
